findings.before: … organisation : l’application … / … publication : sa source … (U+0020 before the colon)
findings.after: U+202F before the colon in both
findings.note: fr style guide (Punctuation & typography): espace fine insécable U+202F is required before : ; ! ? in prose; a plain space also lets the colon wrap to the start of a tooltip line. The namespace already mixes both (25 x U+0020, 13 x U+202F before ':'): those are pre-existing and out of scope.

'Il a été enregistré' has no antecedent in its sentence; it follows '{item} : source non confirmée. Confirmez la source.', whose nearest noun (la source) is feminine, so a reader resolves 'Il' to the item. ru/vi/hi name the link explicitly ('Ce lien a été enregistré…' would match); the current wording is grammatical and understood, so it is left as the translator wrote it.
